items.name: bento-01
items.title: Telemetry Bento
items.description: High-density bento grid featuring an interactive AI query copilot workbench, real-time edge network telemetry feed, live latency radar, and SOC 2 compliance vault status.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Header-grade search/command palette. Bundles the slim trigger button (with platform-aware ⌘K/Ctrl-K kbd hint) AND the modal CommandDialog into one block; consumers drop it once and the global keyboard shortcut wires itself. Takes a `groups` array of `{ heading, items: [{ label, hint, icon, onSelect }] }` and calls `onSelect`. `showTrigger={false}` hides the inline button so the consumer can control open state from elsewhere.

items.name: contact-01
items.title: Sales Contact Form
items.description: Interactive enterprise solutions architect dispatch workbench with track selection, live hub timezones, SLA badges, and ticket generator.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: Conversion CTA
items.description: Interactive developer CTA section with live framework switcher, interactive CLI installation terminal, 1-click clipboard copy, and production guarantees.

items.name: dashboard-layout
items.title: Dashboard Layout
items.description: Full dashboard shell — collapsible sidebar + sticky topbar (sidebar trigger, breadcrumb, theme switch, notifications) + main content children. Drop it around a page: `<DashboardLayout>{page}</DashboardLayout>`.

items.name: faq-01
items.title: Accordion FAQ
items.description: Interactive architecture knowledge base and FAQ section with real-time keyword search, category topic filtering, and helpfulness voting.

items.name: features-01
items.title: Tabbed Feature Matrix
items.description: Interactive enterprise product feature workbench with live module simulations, dynamic directory filters, real-time payroll calculations, continuous SOC 2 compliance verification, and TypeScript API code viewer.

items.name: footer-01
items.title: Multi-Column Footer
items.description: Site footer with brand mark + newsletter form on the left and four link columns (Product / Company / Resources / Legal) on the right. Separator divides into a copyright + social icon row. Each link is spelled out inline so copy lives in one place.

items.name: header-01
items.title: Sticky Top Navbar
items.description: Sticky marketing top-bar. Brand mark on the left, five inline anchor links in the centre on desktop, "Sign in" + primary trial CTA on the right. Below the md breakpoint the right side collapses into a hamburger that opens a right-side Sheet with the same links and CTAs stacked. Translucent background uses backdrop-blur so content can scroll behind it.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Metric Showcase Hero
items.description: Two-column hero with badge eyebrow, large headline, supporting copy, primary + outline CTAs, social proof row, and a collage of three rotated KPI cards (active users / uptime / onboarding queue) on the right.

items.name: logos-01
items.title: Static Logo Grid
items.description: Customer-logo cloud strip. "Trusted by teams at" eyebrow over a responsive grid of six grayscale wordmarks (2 / 3 / 6 columns by breakpoint). Each logo is an inline SVG sitting on currentColor so the muted-foreground → foreground hover swap works. Ships with placeholder marks — swap the SVGs with real customer logos before shipping.

items.name: notifications-popover
items.title: Notifications Popover
items.description: Header-grade notifications panel. Slot-trigger Popover the consumer wraps around their own Bell button. Filter tabs (All/Unread), Today/Earlier groups, category-coloured accent bars, hover-dismiss, mark-all-read, slide-in animation. Slot receives `unreadCount` so the trigger can show a badge.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Seat Pricing Matrix
items.description: Comprehensive enterprise pricing workbench with monthly/annual billing cycle toggle, currency selector (USD/EUR/GBP), team seat simulator slider, dynamic add-on calculators, and an expandable side-by-side feature comparison matrix.

items.name: sidebar-02
items.title: Team Switcher Sidebar
items.description: Full-featured app sidebar -- collapsible="icon" rail with TeamSwitcher header, primary nav, projects section, secondary nav, and user dropdown footer. Each section ships as a sibling file in the same folder so consumers can edit one piece at a time.

items.name: testimonials-01
items.title: Customer Testimonials
items.description: Interactive customer case study and ROI telemetry workbench with industry filters, verified customer metrics, tech stack tags, and autoplay navigation.

items.name: auth-mfa
items.title: Auth Mfa
items.description: Two-step verification surface. 6-digit OTP pin input auto-submits on entry, shows verifying state and an inline error on mismatch, has a 30-second resend cooldown, and swaps to a Verified card with a Continue button on success. Emits `verify` (code), `resend`, and `continue`. `demoCode` prop controls the value the built-in mock validator accepts.

items.name: auth-password-reset
items.title: Auth Password Reset
items.description: Four-stage password reset surface in a single card: request (email form) -> sent (check-your-inbox confirmation with "Open reset form" demo button) -> reset (new password + confirm with match validation) -> done (success confirmation linking back to sign-in). Emits `request` (email) when the link is asked for and `reset` (password) when the new password is set; consumer wires the actual mail/db calls.

items.name: auth-sign-in
items.title: Auth Sign In
items.description: Full-page sign-in surface. Email + password + remember-me form, forgot-password and sign-up links, optional GitHub/Google OAuth row. Emits `submit` with the form payload and `oauth` with the chosen provider; consumer wires the actual auth call. Link targets are configurable via props.

items.name: auth-sign-up
items.title: Auth Sign Up
items.description: Full-page sign-up surface. Name/email/password/confirm form with password-match validation, T&C acceptance gate, optional OAuth row, link back to sign-in. Emits `submit` with the validated payload and `oauth` with provider; consumer wires the actual auth call.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked, collapsible panels — one or many open at a time. Use for FAQs, settings groups, and any place where space is tight but content needs to stay browsable. Built on Radix UI with smooth animation and full keyboard support.

items.name: advance-select
items.title: Advance Select
items.description: Searchable, async-capable select with keyboard navigation, multi-select, and option grouping. Drop in when the native `<select>` or the basic Select primitive runs out of room — large lists, debounced server-side filtering, custom rendered items.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Static, in-flow notice block with a leading icon, title, and description. Use for inline page-level messages — info banners, success confirmations, warning callouts. Two tones: `default` and `destructive`.

items.name: alert-modal
items.title: Alert Modal
items.description: Props-driven shortcut for confirm and destructive prompts — pass `title`, `description`, `actionLabel`, and a `tone` and you get a fully styled modal with a leading icon ring, action button, and optional async loading state. Skip it and use Dialog when you need a free-form modal instead.

items.name: alluvial-chart
items.title: Alluvial Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/alluvial-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.description: Tweened number display — counts up on mount and smoothly retargets when the value changes. Ease-out cubic via requestAnimationFrame, custom formatter (Intl-ready), delay/stagger support, honors prefers-reduced-motion, SSR-safe.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/area-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Wraps content (typically images, video, or iframes) at a fixed width:height ratio so it never letterboxes or jumps as it loads. Common ratios: 16/9 for video, 1/1 for avatars, 4/3 for cards.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Single file or image chip. Drive look with props: state, size, orientation, media, src, removable. Not a dropzone (see file-upload).

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round or rounded-square user image with a fallback that shows initials or an icon when the image is missing or fails to load. Sizes from xs to 2xl, optional status dot, and a group composition for stacked avatar lists.

items.name: back-top
items.title: Back Top
items.description: Scroll-to-top floating button. Appears after the target container scrolls past a threshold and smooth-scrolls back on click. Supports custom target container, visibility threshold, scroll behavior, custom icon slot, four edge anchors, size variants, and edge offset.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small inline label for status, counts, or tags — sits beside other content, not as a standalone control. Seven variants: `default`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `outline`, `success`, `warning`, `info`.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/bar-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: bar-race-chart
items.title: Bar Race Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/bar-race-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: beeswarm-chart
items.title: Beeswarm Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/beeswarm-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: block-ui
items.title: Block Ui
items.description: Overlay that blocks interaction during loading. Wraps content and shows a spinner + message overlay. The blocking prop toggles the blocked state with configurable overlay opacity, color, background blur, and custom icon/message slots. Composes the spinner primitive.

items.name: board
items.title: Board — compositional kanban / sortable-list primitive
items.description: Six small composable components for any board / kanban / sortable-list surface — opinionated about drop targeting and animation, agnostic about layout, data, and chrome. Drop `<Board>` around a grid of `<BoardLane>` columns; nest `<BoardLaneHeader>`, `<BoardLaneBody>`, `<BoardLaneEmpty>`, and `<BoardCard>` items inside each lane. State lives in a sibling `useBoard()` hook (insertion-index drop math, keyboard a11y, accept predicate). Cards use native HTML5 drag-and-drop (draggable + onDragStart / onLaneDragOver / onLaneDrop) — the lane components emit drag events up to the consumer, which threads them through useBoard and feeds the resulting state back in as props. Three-level React context (board → lane → card) mirrors the Timeline / Card sub-component pattern.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: Rotating conic light beam that traces the border ring of its parent. Place inside a `relative` parent (e.g. a Card); the overlay is absolutely positioned, pointer-events-none, and masked down to a ring of `size` px thickness. Tune `duration`, `delay`, and `color`, or set `paused` to freeze it. Keyframes and the `--uipkge-border-angle` @property ship in the canonical tailwind tokens — re-pull init/tailwind if upgrading.

items.name: bottom-navigation
items.title: Bottom Navigation
items.description: Mobile bottom tab bar with icon + label items. Supports value/defaultValue for the active item, an active color, fixed positioning at the viewport bottom, badges on items, and a `to` prop for link integration.

items.name: boxplot-chart
items.title: Boxplot Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/boxplot-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Hierarchical wayfinding strip that shows a user’s position in a nested page tree. Built from `<BreadcrumbList>` and `<BreadcrumbItem>` primitives so you can drop in custom separators, dropdowns for collapsed parents, and ellipsis for overflow.

items.name: bubble-chart
items.title: Bubble Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/bubble-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: bubble-map
items.title: Bubble Map
items.description: Proportional symbol bubble map as dependency-free SVG. Eliminates geographic landmass distortion by scaling circle areas to continuous quantitative values with mathematical square-root radius normalization, pulsating concentric ripple rings, multi-tier size legend, and interactive hover cards.

items.name: bullet-chart
items.title: Bullet Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/bullet-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Interactive button component with variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link), sizes, and composite ButtonGroup container for segmented toolbars and split buttons.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Single-month calendar grid for date selection (react-day-picker). Use inline or in a custom popover. For form fields, use Date Picker. Supports min/max, disabled dates, multi-month, and locale.

items.name: calendar-heatmap
items.title: Calendar Heatmap
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/calendar-heatmap — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/candlestick-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Bordered container with an opinionated header / content / footer layout. Use it as the wrapper around any self-contained block of content — settings panels, dashboard tiles, list cells.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Horizontal or vertical scroller with previous/next controls. Built on embla-carousel-react (the official shadcn carousel pattern) and wired through a React context. Drop in images, cards, or any custom slide content.

items.name: cascade-select
items.title: Cascade Select
items.description: Hierarchical cascading select where each level selection determines the next level options. Displays the selected path as labels. Supports search, clearable, disabled, and loading states.

items.name: category-distribution-chart
items.title: Category Distribution Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/category-distribution-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Meta-bundle that installs every chart wrapper at once -- 65 charts spanning cartesian (area / bar / stacked-bar / stacked-area / line / range-area / control / slope / scatter / effect-scatter / bubble / quadrant / candlestick / heikin-ashi / range-bar / marimekko / theme-river / waterfall / combo / pareto / polar-bar / pictorial-bar / lollipop / dumbbell / histogram / gantt / bar-race / population-pyramid), circular (pie / donut / nightingale / radar / gauge / segmented-gauge / liquid-fill / progress-ring), hierarchy (treemap / funnel / smooth-funnel / sunburst / icicle / tree), flow (sankey / chord / alluvial / graph / parallel), distribution (boxplot / violin / beeswarm / error-bar / bullet), specialty (heatmap / calendar-heatmap / sparkline / word-cloud / waffle / uptime-tracker / category-distribution), maps (dotted-map / choropleth-map / us-choropleth / us-tile-grid / us-symbol-map), and the raw escape hatch. Each is also installable on its own.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Standalone or in-form binary toggle, built on Radix UI. Supports indeterminate state for tri-state lists, sizes, and proper keyboard / screen-reader behavior. Pair with Label for clickable text.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Compact, removable tag — typically used inside `tags-input` or as a filter pill. Seven variants (`default`, `filled`, `outlined`, `elevated`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`), three sizes, and an optional close button.

items.name: chord-chart
items.title: Chord Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/chord-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: choropleth-map-chart
items.title: Choropleth Map Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/choropleth-map-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: circular-progress
items.title: Circular Progress
items.description: Radial/circular progress indicator. Supports value (0-100), size presets or custom pixel size, stroke thickness, custom arc and track colors, indeterminate spinning mode, a label slot for center content, and a show-value prop that renders the percentage in the center.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: Clipboard
items.description: Copy-to-clipboard button with success/error feedback. Swaps the icon to a check on success, shows a tooltip with configurable feedback text, supports a visible label, disabled state, a custom timeout for feedback reset, and copy/success/error events. Includes a legacy execCommand fallback for non-secure contexts. Composes the tooltip primitive.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Syntax-highlighted code preview with a language header, copy button, optional line numbers, and collapsible `<pre>` content. Use for installation snippets, API examples, and source you want users to copy verbatim.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Headless single-region show/hide primitive. Use it when Accordion is overkill — a single toggle reveals one panel of content. Smooth height animation built in.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Hex / RGB color input with a popover swatch grid. Supports controlled and uncontrolled modes, alpha channel, and a recent-colors row.

items.name: combo-chart
items.title: Combo Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/combo-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command palette à la Cmd-K — keyboard-driven menu with grouped items, icons, shortcuts, and fuzzy filtering. Use as a global launcher (mounted in a Dialog) or inline as a typeahead select.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click menu — same primitives as Dropdown Menu but triggered by `contextmenu` events. Drop on any element you want to attach row actions, file-system style operations, or copy/paste menus to.

items.name: control-chart
items.title: Control Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/control-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: Countdown timer that shows time remaining to a target date. Digits flip on each tick. Supports DD:HH:MM:SS, HH:MM:SS, MM:SS, and SS formats plus custom token formats, render props for days/hours/minutes/seconds, a label, leading-zero padding, a custom separator, paused state, and on-finish/tick events.

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data List
items.description: Vertical key/value list for showing read-only metadata — invoice details, settings summaries, profile fields. Pair items in label/value rows; supports inline edit triggers and trailing actions per row.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Full-feature table with sorting, filtering, column pinning, pagination, row selection, and an opinionated header/toolbar. Built on TanStack Table — pass `columns` + `data` and configure as needed.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Form date control: trigger + popover + Calendar/RangeCalendar + optional time. Single/multiple/range, week/month/quarter/year pickers, presets, confirm mode, min/max and disabled dates. For an always-visible grid, use Calendar instead.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Free-form modal primitive — composable from `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, and friends. Use for forms, info cards, pickers, and any custom modal layout. For confirm/destructive prompts, prefer the prebuilt `AlertModal` shortcut.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: macOS-style dock menu with magnification on hover. Items expand as the cursor approaches using a cosine bell curve. Supports an items array (icon + label + handler), magnification scale, base size, tooltips on hover, click handlers, and an active state indicator.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/donut-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: dotted-map-chart
items.title: Dotted Map Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/dotted-map-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Floating menu launched from a trigger button — for account switchers, row actions, editor menus, and any short list of commands. Supports labels, icons, separators, keyboard shortcuts, checkbox/radio items, and nested submenus. Built on Radix UI; ARIA + keyboard navigation handled.

items.title: Dumbbell Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/dumbbell-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: effect-scatter-chart

items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/effect-scatter-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centered placeholder with icon, headline, supporting text, and one or two actions. Drop into empty lists, blank dashboards, and unauthenticated views — the standard "nothing here yet" pattern.

items.name: error-bar-chart
items.title: Error Bar Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/error-bar-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event Calendar
items.description: Full-featured event calendar primitive supporting month, week, day, work-week, and category/resource views, timed interval grids with collision clustering, all-day header, live current-time indicator, and customizable event templates.

items.name: fab
items.title: Fab
items.description: Floating action button — a fixed or absolute positioned circular button for the primary screen action. Supports an icon (default), an extended label variant, mini/large sizes, four color variants, six anchor positions, and a disabled state.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop file dropzone with click-to-browse fallback, file-type filtering, multi-file support, and per-file progress + remove controls. Wraps native `<input type="file">` with proper a11y.

items.name: float-label
items.title: Float Label

items.name: form

items.name: histogram-chart

items.name: hover-card

items.name: icicle-chart
items.title: Icicle Chart
items.description: React mirror of @uipkge/icicle-chart — see the Vue registry item for the canonical description.

items.name: icon-box
items.title: Icon Box
items.description: Icon container primitive with calibrated sizes (2xs to xl), surface variants (solid, outline, subtle, primary, muted), and 2.5D layered IconStack for empty states and feature hero cards.

items.name: icon-transition
items.title: Icon Transition
items.description: Animated icon swap for click acknowledgements — copy → check, bookmark → bookmark-filled, follow → follower. Pass two icon components and an async `action`; clicking runs the action then springs the active icon in. Auto-reverts after `resetAfter` ms (default 1500), or pass `0` to keep the active icon and call the exposed `reset()` method to flip it back. Renders as a `<button>` by default; use `as="span"` plus the `active` prop when you want an externally controlled, non-interactive icon swap inside another control. Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: Showcase + recipe page for the registry’s default icon set (Lucide). Not a runtime component — install the npm package directly. Documented here so consumers can browse names and import recipes.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image Compare
items.description: Before/after image comparison slider with a draggable divider. Two images overlaid via clip-path, pointer-driven (mouse + touch), horizontal or vertical orientation, custom handle render prop, labels, and disabled state.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Single image cropper. Drive look with props: aspectRatio, showZoom, rounded, minZoom, maxZoom, disabled.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: Load-more-on-scroll sentinel. Calls an onLoadMore callback when the user scrolls near the bottom (or top, in reverse mode). Supports a window or element scroll target, distance threshold, loading/hasMore/disabled gating, and slots for custom loading and end-of-list states.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input — single-line. Three sizes, three variants (outlined / filled / borderless), error / warning status, prefix / suffix nodes, addonBefore / addonAfter, allow-clear, password toggle, char count, and composite InputGroup with addons and action buttons.

items.name: json-tree-view
items.title: Json Tree View
items.description: Collapsible JSON tree viewer with color-coded value types, click-to-copy, live search/filter, and expand/collapse-all controls. Renders objects, arrays, and primitives with configurable depth and contained scrolling.

items.name: kanban

items.description: Composable compound Kanban primitive for building board, pipeline, and agile workflows with tactile card drag-and-drop mechanics.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Inline keyboard-key indicator — renders a single key or shortcut in monospace with a subtle bordered chip.

items.name: knob

items.description: Circular dial input. Drag to rotate, keyboard accessible, SVG-rendered. Useful for compact numeric controls (volume, brightness, gauges).

items.name: kpi-grid
items.title: Kpi Grid
items.description: Bare responsive grid wrapper (2 / 3 / 4 columns). Pass any children — Cards, inline charts, custom tiles. No items prop, no item rendering.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label primitive — wraps text and binds to its child input via `htmlFor`. Disabled-state styling and proper screen-reader behavior.

items.name: labeled-value
items.title: Labeled Value
items.description: Read-only label/value pair for surface details — "Email: jane@…" or "Status: Active". Compose them in a Data List, a Stat Card, or a Section Card detail row.

items.name: lazy-image
items.title: Lazy Image
items.description: Lazy-loaded image with aspect-ratio reservation, skeleton placeholder, fade-in transition, and error fallback. Composes loading="lazy" with IntersectionObserver for off-viewport hold and pairs with the skeleton primitive for the placeholder state.

items.name: leaflet-map
items.title: Leaflet Map
items.description: A thin, theme-aware Leaflet wrapper rendering free raster tiles (OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, Esri) — no API key required. Drop LeafletMarker / LeafletPopup / LeafletPolyline / LeafletGeoJson into the children to build any map — fleet boards, journey maps, store locators. The base style follows light/dark automatically, an opt-in `muted` prop desaturates the tile pane so overlaid data is the only colour, and `onCreated` hands you the raw L.Map instance for custom layers and fitBounds. The Mapbox counterpart (`map`) adds GL styles, 3D, and globe; this one trades those for zero-key setup. Import `leaflet/dist/leaflet.css` once — the component does it for you.
